tokens.name: --gridkit-surface
tokens.description: The background of the header, footer, toolbar, group-by bar, pager and menus, and of their buttons and fields.

tokens.name: --gridkit-surface-muted
tokens.description: The background of a hovered row, cell, header, button or option, and of group rows.

tokens.name: --gridkit-line
tokens.description: Borders, separators and the lines between rows and columns.

tokens.name: --gridkit-hover-line
tokens.description: The outline of a hovered cell and the edge of a column being resized.

tokens.name: --gridkit-fg
tokens.description: The text of the toolbar, pager, menus and fields, while cells and headers keep the page's own text colour.

tokens.name: --gridkit-fg-muted
tokens.description: Secondary text, icons and the scrollbar thumb.

tokens.name: --gridkit-accent
tokens.description: Focus rings, drop indicators, the current page, and the marks of an active sort, group, filter or check.

tokens.name: --gridkit-selected
tokens.description: The background of a selected row, column or cell, a focused menu item and a group-by chip.

tokens.name: --gridkit-selected-strong
tokens.description: The background of a selected row, column or cell while hovered, and of a toolbar toggle that is on.

tokens.name: --gridkit-radius
tokens.description: The corner radius of the grid's outer frame and of the pager bar.
